title: A local fact that really can be proved.
prompt: Let n = 2k + 1 be an odd integer. Which proves its next Collatz value is even?
hint: Substitute the defining form of an odd integer.

options.text: The graph seems to alternate between odd and even.
The next value is always smaller than n.

feedback.pass: This proves a particular parity property of the update, not eventual arrival at 1 for every start.
feedback.fail: Use the integer witness in the definition of oddness. The odd branch often increases the value.
